pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Triggered alert INC-2026-142 - High 5xx rate on /v1/generate. Escalation policy: SRE Oncall. Triggered at 2026-03-14 15:12:19 UTC

maria (oncall): ack'ing now. seeing spike in 500s from runtime pool rdx-gpu-2

maria (oncall): checking logs, tail:
```
2026-03-14T15:12:05Z inference|ERROR| request_id=abc123 status=500 model=h2o-13b seq=512 latency_ms=12.3
2026-03-14T15:12:06Z inference|ERROR| request_id=def456 status=500 model=h2o-13b seq=64 latency_ms=8.9
```

incident-bot: Page acknowledged by maria (oncall) at 15:13:02 UTC

dan (sre): joining. do we have any rollbacks or autoscale events?

maria (oncall): autoscaler scaled up 2 nodes at 15:11:50 but 5xx persists. suspect OOM on worker; CPU and memory spike on rdx-3

jess (eng-runtime): adding collector logs, repeated CUDA OOM in process pid=4421. dumping stack to /tmp/oom-1749999999.log

maria (oncall): starting canary reroute -> route traffic to model-variant quantized/b2. Command:
```
/tools/routing set-fallback --from model=h2o-13b --to model=h2o-13b-q4 --percent=100
```

maria (oncall): paging secondary - kevin (oncall-manager) - escalating; PD didn't auto-escalate yet

pagerduty-bot: 8m elapsed without secondary ack. Escalating to manager kevin (oncall-manager) :arrow_up:

kevin (oncall-manager): on it. coordinating infra to power-cycle rdx-3 and validate disk + dmesg. who's impacted?

support-ops: affected tenants: Acme Corp (prod), Finly (prod), BizCorp (staging). opening support cases and notifying CS leads.

maria (oncall): traffic reroute completed at 15:20 UTC. error rate dropped from 4.2% -> 0.12% over 5m window

dan (sre): confirming metrics in grafana, latency normals resumed. :thumbsup:

kevin (oncall-manager): leaving watch for 1hr. plan: node power-cycle + runtime hotfix to add OOM guard. if stable, we'll mark mitigated and prepare RCA

maria (oncall): handoff to dan at 16:10 UTC (shift end). Handoff notes: reroute active, rdx-3 reboot in progress, support cases opened for Acme/Finly, collector logs uploaded to /artifacts/INC-2026-142/

dan (sre): ack. I'll monitor for regressions and start RCA doc

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-142: status=mitigated, mitigation=traffic_reroute, timeline_updated

kevin (oncall-manager): tagging follow-up: @jess please lead RCA; initial hypothesis: memory leak in attention cache. please coordinate with research and eng-runtime

jess (eng-runtime): will take. ETA for RCA initial draft: tomorrow EOD

maria (oncall): cleared PD alerts on my side. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
